notes.title: Update Notes for March 2024
notes.notes:
- Removed the winter seasonal art (it's spring!).
- Minor improvements and cleanup (spring cleaning!).

notes.title: Update Notes for January 28, 2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a subtle bug with "ghost" dice that would disappear when selected.
[*] Improved the easy and hard bots to be more challenging.
[*] Switched to winter seasonal title art.
[*] Various miscellaneous updates for small bugs, typos, and general quality.
[/list]

notes.title: Seasonal Art and other small changes

[/list]

[*] Minor changes to Credits screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with resuming a single player game after having played a multiplayer game.
[*] Improved functionality of the Resume button.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a resume bug if resuming the game while splitting the dice pools.
[*] Fixed a game freezing bug.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Multiplayer online games are now easier to create and join.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved the pointer positioning for game controller play.
[*] Improved the audio scaling.
[*] Added small shadows to dice.
[*] Other minor improvements and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added ability to scroll the game event log.
[*] Added the D-Pad controller bindings to improve the Steam Deck experience.
[*] Fixed a bug with the pointer appearing in mid screen in some circumstance.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the confirmation dialog OK button from working.
[*] Fixed a bug with the controller pointer being hidden when over the game cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.3.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added initial support for game controllers.
[*] Added a visibility message when button is toggled.
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow players to click the increase resource track button even if the glow button wasn't visible.
[*] Fixed a bug with player difficulty settings not saving properly.
[*] Fixed 2 issues with achievements and reduced requirements for gold achievement to 60 and VP achievement to 40.
[*] Sped up the animations and AI a bit.
[*] Renamed the Designer label to just Design on the Credits dialog.
[*] Miscellaneous improvements and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.2.10
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the Friar achievement which prevented unlocking it.
[*] Minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.2.9
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a visibility toggle button in-game to allow players to make the cards partially transparent to see the dice behind them (useful for resolutions where they obscure some dice).
[*] Visibility button also enables hiding the end game scroll so players can see the final state of the game.
[*] Fixed a rare bug related to the +/- adjustment die (similar to a prior fix with the +/+ and -/- adjustment dice).
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.2.8
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes a rare bug which would lock up the game if some very specific value dice configurations happen with a +/+ or -/- adjustment die.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for v1.2.7
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added 3 new achievements.
[*] Improved AI.
[*] Other minor improvements.
[/list]
